An account's own hosts: add a machine to your personal account or an organisation, list, drain and remove them.

:::caution
Experimental: a deployment serves these only with `KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS=experimental`.
:::

## Make a join token for one of your own hosts

`POST /v1/hosts/join-tokens` (SDK method `createAccountJoinToken`)

A one-use token, shown once, and the one-line command that installs the host agent on a Linux machine and joins it to the account (the caller's personal account unless `account` names an organisation). The host dials out to this deployment and keeps the connection open, so it needs no inbound port. Once it has joined, the account's new sandboxes go on its own hosts, and no other account's sandboxes ever do. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned account hosts on (`KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS`).

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry is `conflict` (`details.idempotencyKey` `in_progress`): retry it later. A first call that didn't finish (it failed part way, or stopped answering) is never done again under its key: a retry is `conflict` (`held`), so check, then use a new key. The same key with a different request is `refused`. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [CreateAccountJoinTokenBody](/api/reference/types/#createaccountjointokenbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [AccountJoinToken](/api/reference/types/#accountjointoken) (`application/json`). The token and its command.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `409` conflict, `422` refused, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## List an account's hosts

`GET /v1/hosts` (SDK method `listAccountHosts`)

The hosts joined to the account, revoked ones included. The deployment's shared hosts aren't listed. A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned account hosts on (`KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS`).

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | string | no | The account to act in: the caller's personal account (the default for a person) or an organisation they belong to. An API key always acts in its own account, and naming another is `forbidden`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [HostList](/api/reference/types/#hostlist) (`application/json`). The hosts.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

`GET /v1/hosts/{hostId}` (SDK method `getAccountHost`)

A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned account hosts on (`KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change one of an account's hosts

`PATCH /v1/hosts/{hostId}` (SDK method `updateAccountHost`)

Renames it, replaces its labels, drains it, or sets its limit on each account's saved snapshots. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned account hosts on (`KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateHostBody](/api/reference/types/#updatehostbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Remove one of an account's hosts

`DELETE /v1/hosts/{hostId}` (SDK method `removeAccountHost`)

Revokes its credential and closes its connection. Its sandboxes keep their disks but can't be reached until it joins again. Run `sudo kantel-host uninstall` on the machine to take the agent off it. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned account hosts on (`KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host, revoked.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get one of an account's hosts' usage

`GET /v1/hosts/{hostId}/usage` (SDK method `getAccountHostUsage`)

Its CPU, memory and disk as it reported them, every 5 seconds over the last hour. Poll with `since` set to the last point's `at` for only the newer points. A key needs `account:read`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned account hosts on (`KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `since` | integer | no | Only the points after this time (epoch milliseconds). |

**Answers**

- `200`: [HostUsage](/api/reference/types/#hostusage) (`application/json`). The host's readings.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Update the agent of one of an account's hosts

`POST /v1/hosts/{hostId}/update` (SDK method `updateAccountHostAgent`)

Asks the host to update its host agent to `latestVersion`, which it does when `updateAvailable` says so: it fetches that release's `kantel-host`, checks it against the release's `SHA256SUMS` and restarts into it. Its sandboxes keep running, but connections to them through Kantel (SSH, terminals, ports) drop for the few seconds it takes to connect again. Answers once the host has the new binary, with `updating` set until it connects on it. `conflict` when it's revoked or already up to date, `unavailable` when it isn't connected or the latest release can't be read, and `not_supported` when the host refuses. A key needs `account:admin`. Experimental: `not_supported` unless the deployment has turned account hosts on (`KANTEL_ACCOUNT_HOSTS`).

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hostId` | string | yes | The host's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Host](/api/reference/types/#host) (`application/json`). The host, updating.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
